case_number: 2024 INSC 559; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 8127 OF 2024; ARISING OUT OF SLP (C) NO. 20844 OF 2022; CONTEMPT PETITION (CIVIL) NO. 217 OF 2024

parties.respondent: Harihar Krupa Co-Operative Housing Society Limited & ORS.

summary: Slum redevelopment delay; Section 13(2) Maharashtra Slum Areas Act duty to complete within time; termination justified after 18 years delay; limited judicial review scope; phases: 2003-2011 initial delay, 2011-2014 clearance delays, 2014-2019 slum dweller conflicts, 2015-2017 inaction; financial incapacity defense rejected; locus standi confirmed; SRA power coupled with duty; precedent cited Susme Builders.
legal_provisions_cited: Maharashtra Slum Areas (Improvement, Clearance and Redevelopment) Act, 1971 S.13(2)
Susme Builders Pvt. Ltd. v. CEO, Slum Rehabilitation Authority & Ors.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court affirmed; termination order upheld; slum redevelopment project to proceed with alternate developer.
